description: Read your film's change request, deletion request and, while Vidreno's checks hold it, the hold: what was found and what each finding means, whether you asked for a manual review, the conversation with the Vidreno team, the evidence files you sent, and what you can do next. For a film removed because nobody answered its hold, restore_offer says whether return_film_to_draft can bring it back. No admin-only review scores or diagnostics.
name: get_film_workflow
title: get film workflow
